name: Windy Point overlook parking lot on the Catalina Highway
basis: Windy Point West page: park at the Windy Point parking area, cross the highway past the restrooms. Mapped lot sits on the Windy Point overlook (~0.2 km from the sector coordinate); a second mapped lot ~40 m away is the same overlook.

name: Windy Point overlook parking lot on the Catalina Highway
basis: Windy Point East page: most climbs best reached by parking in the large Windy Point lot or in pullouts just downhill (mile marker 13.6-13.7); the large lot is used as the sector default. Matched by position (~0.25 km).
